notes.title: New Update! v0.17
notes.content:
Patch Note v0.17
⚠️ Major Changes

Added a mini-map in the TAB menu to help you navigate the swamp.

Inventory rework: you can now manage your items directly from the TAB menu or a chest.

🔥 New Features

New loot panel UI to visualize your gains when collecting items (barrels, chests, etc.).

Added a wheat field in the village on the hill.

Integrated a feedback system directly into the demo (your feedback is essential ❤️).

Added a key rebind menu (still in beta).

New vegetables available from the traveling merchant.

Improved interaction highlights: objects hovered by the player are now clearly emphasized.

Added drag & drop support for items in the inventory and chests.

🎨 Balancing & Improvements

Improved pathfinding/navmesh for more natural NPC movement.

Adjusted starter item values.

Various tweaks to collisions, navigation, and object placement.

Improved UI for orders, recruitment, and inventory.

🐛 Bug Fixes

Fixed various soft lock issues.

Fixed the bug where the cooking pot could get stuck on its stand.

Removed ghost merchants appearing under the map.

Fixed NPC dialogues and cleaned up translations.

Improved resolution detection in the graphics options.
[hr][/hr]
👉 Thanks again for all your feedback — it’s invaluable for improving Medieval StartUp. Keep sharing your impressions on the Steam forum, I read every single one 🙏

Florian / Aspic Games

notes.title: New update! v0.15
notes.content:
Patch Note v0.15

⚠️ Major Changes


Loan system → finance your projects and grow your tavern faster.

End-of-day panel → view your earnings, expenses, and your game’s progress.

Main menu overhaul and several interface panels updated.

Translations: added Italian, Spanish, and German.

 
🔥 New Features


Multiple saves: you can now have several save files.

“Delete Save” button added in the save management menu.

New ladder and player’s bedroom above the kitchen, allowing you to sleep and skip the night from 9 pm.

 
🎨 Balancing & Improvements


Price rebalance: apple, apple juice, suspicious stew, bouquet of flowers.

Improved animations for stand employees and customers: they now turn toward their target before starting the animation.

Job selection reworked: buttons with icons to choose an employee’s role.

Closing the crafting panel → cancels the ongoing craft and refunds the resources.

Better tree collision management.

Plant growth now depends on the game world time instead of playtime (faster at night).

Improved interaction with NPCs and their spawning.

New player controller → smoother movement and more precise interactions.

Complete text localization: bedroom panels, announcements, employee panel, loans, and shop.

 
🐛 Bug Fixes


Fixed NPC dialogues and spawning issues.

Fixed an issue where bread dough was unavailable.

Adjustments to the tutorial and object display.

Visual polishes and various optimizations.

 
💬 Thanks for all your feedback!
Try out this new version and feel free to share your impressions on the Steam forum. Your experience helps shape Medieval StartUp! 😄

notes.title: New Update ! v0.14
notes.content:
Patch Note v0.14

⚠️ Major Changes

- Steam integration is now supported in the game (Overlay, Achievements, Statistics)
- Day/night and weather systems have been overhauled
- New save system implemented
- Employee orders can now be given directly from the employee panel
- New visual identity (logo, banner, etc.)

🔥 New Features

🏆 Steam Achievements
The game is now connected to your Steam account, with newly added achievements and the future possibility of statistics and other account-linked data.

⛅ New day/night and weather system
A new skybox has been implemented, and environmental effects have been improved to better reflect different times of day.
Weather and time now influence customer visits and their orders. (On sunny days, refreshing drinks will be more popular, while warm meals will be favored in rainy weather.)

💾 Save System
The game now features 4 separate save slots: one for autosave (compatible with previous saves), and three for manual saves.
When loading the game, you can choose which save to launch, with a short summary showing your tavern's name and status (gold/level/day).

📌 Employee Tasks
A new tab has been added to the Employee Board: the Tasks tab.
It explains each job role and allows you to assign tasks specific to each type of job.

🎨 General Improvements

- New visual identity for the game!

- Price balancing: prices for some items have been adjusted

- The Hunter (merchant) is no longer in the skill tree and is now present in the swamp from the start. His location has been moved further east, away from the tavern

- Tree rendering fixes: in low quality settings, trees reappeared when moving away. Tree clearing during construction has also been improved

- AI improvements: employee and merchant AI has been optimized

- Bug fixes: various minor gameplay and display issues have been resolved

- Pumpkins now have an additional growth stage

- Preparations for the brewing barrel and bread oven are now properly saved

- Room rentals now resume normally after loading a save

- Customer spawn rate and pacing have been reworked

- It’s now easier to place items on stands and the counter (clicking is now based on the green preview object, not the surface)

- Employees now emit sounds when walking or performing actions to enhance immersion

- French/English translations have been improved

Thank you all for your feedback!
Try out this new version and feel free to share your thoughts on the Steam forums.
Your feedback helps shape the future of Medieval StartUp! 😄

The game is available in PlayTest until the next update!

notes.title: New Update ! v0.13
notes.content:
Patch Note v0.13

⚠️ Major Changes

- Added the new Lumberjack job for employees

- Employees now have a customizable schedule with work hours set by the player

- Dormitories have been replaced by tents and houses that you can build and place freely

- Complete overhaul of the merchant interface

- Tips have been removed: you can now boost shop selling prices using the skill tree and Mystic Points

🔥 New Features

🪓 The Lumberjack
A new job is available: the Lumberjack.
An employee with enough strength can cut dead trees around the tavern and deposit wood in storage. The higher their strength, the faster they work!

🪙 Merchant System Overhaul
Merchants now have a daily restocking inventory.
They visit twice a day, once in the morning and once in the late afternoon, offering a wider range of goods.

📅 Work Schedule
The type of housing impacts how many hours an employee can work per day:
- Tent: 8 working hours
- Bed: 12 working hours
You can manage shifts directly from the Employee Panel.

📺 New Graphic Option: High Performance Mode
A "High Performance" graphics setting has been added for players with lower-end PCs.

🏕️ Permanent Merchants
Some merchants, like the lumberjack lady or the miner, are now permanently stationed on the map. Their stock refreshes daily.

🎨 General Improvements

- UI improvements: Several adjustments to make the interface more intuitive

- Price balancing: Some item prices have been updated to match new mechanics and recipes

- The lumberjack merchant is now available from the start in the swamp area (east of the tavern) and no longer needs to be unlocked via the skill tree

- Performance optimizations: Smoother and more stable gameplay

- AI improvements: Better behavior for employees and merchants

- Bug fixes: Various small gameplay and display issues resolved

- Seed behavior fixed: Planted seeds can no longer be picked up, and dropping a seed with F no longer causes it to grow anywhere

Thanks for all your amazing feedback!
Give this new version a try and share your thoughts on the Steam forum.
Your feedback helps shape Medieval StartUp! 😄

The game remains available in PlayTest until the next version!

notes.title: New Update - V 0.12
notes.content:
Patch Note v0.12

⚠️ Major Changes

New Sales System for Stalls

  Stalls now feature an improved sales system, enabling smoother stock and automated sales management. Products are directly placed in stock, and passersby purchase them as they see them. No need to serve customers, and no more queues at the stands.

🔥 New Features

🔨 The Blacksmith

A new profession is now available: The Blacksmith.

Several new recipes have been added with this profession, allowing you to create nails and tools from new resources.

📖 Quest Book Added

A quest book has been added to track missions and objectives.

The book allows you to view tasks to complete in the game, along with associated rewards. It also provides hints to help you complete these quests.

You can also visually track completed and ongoing missions.

🧭 Compass Added

A compass has been added to show your orientation and the location of the tavern.

It also displays elements related to quests.

🌍 New Translation System

A new translation system has been implemented, improving language management and making it easier to add translations for future updates.

Texts that aren't translated will now be shown in English by default.

🎨 General Improvements

User Interface Enhancements: Adjustments have been made to make the interface more intuitive, especially for managing stalls and employees.

Save Improvement: Recruited employees, tavern opening, and placed furniture are now correctly saved. Dishes in service (on tables) will now be considered dirty when the game is reloaded.

Price Balancing: The price of some items has been adjusted to better match the new mechanics and recipes.

Performance Optimization: Improvements have been made to make the game run more smoothly and efficiently.

AI Enhancements: The AI of employees and merchants has been optimized, and the server has been revamped for better performance.

Bug Fixes: Several fixes have been made to resolve minor gameplay and display issues.

Thanks to everyone for your valuable feedback! Be sure to try out this new version and share your thoughts on the Steam forum. Your experience is our priority! 😄

notes.title: New Update - v 0.10
notes.content:
Patch Notes v0.10

⚠️ Major Changes

    Announcement board removed: Buildings can no longer be unlocked through this board.
    Recipes are no longer unlocked automatically.
    Employees are no longer recruited via announcements.

🔥 New Features

🔓 Progression and Unlocking System

    A skill tree has been added to unlock buildings and recipes.
    It uses reputation points for progression.
    Unlocking buildings also requires gold.

👥 Improved Employee Management

    An employee management panel is now available in the tavern.
    Employee Recruitment:
    Employees are now hired through the recruitment panel.
    A free bed is required for each new employee.
    Flexible Jobs:
    Employees can change jobs at any time.
    Jobs now depend on the employee’s skill level.
    Employees now have skill levels in:
        Movement speed
        Cooking level
        Crafting level
        Sociability
    Some jobs require a minimum skill level in certain areas.
    Employees can now be fired. However, their daily salary will still be paid.

🛤️ Trade Routes and Commerce

    The homeless NPC linked to roads has been removed.
    Roads now attract merchants and unlock a village order panel.
    This allows bulk order sales with a reputation bonus.

🎨 General Improvements

    Improved UI and usability.
    The game’s primary language is now English.
    New untranslated content will default to English.
    Options menu improved:
    Now accessible from the main menu.
    Graphics settings and resolution options added.
    Tutorial rework:
    Now allows step validation and rewards upon completion.
    Correctly saved now.
    Improved saving system:
    Employees and their assigned jobs are now properly saved.

Thank you all for your feedback, which helps improve the game! Try out this new version and share your thoughts on the Steam forum. 😀

notes.title: Patch 001 - New Start
notes.content:
New Update Available! 🎉

A new version of Medieval StartUp is live, featuring rebalancing for the early game and various improvements to enhance the overall experience. Here are the details:

Changes and Balancing

    Removed Dishes: Apple Bowl and Mushroom Bowl have been removed.
    New Culinary Start: Suspicious Stew is now available from the start, with a revised recipe.
    Cooking recipes have been moved to the cooking cauldron, while chopping tasks remain on the chopping board (formerly Kitchen Workshop T1).

Early Game Improvements

    Adjusted Starting Setup:
    You now start with 2 tables (2 seats each), 2 pots, and a cooking cauldron (for preparing Apple Juice Pot and Suspicious Stew Pot).

Tavern and Interaction Enhancements

    Tavern clients can now arrive in groups of 2.
    The server can now directly serve dishes from pots placed on work surfaces.
    Tavern T1 has been updated with a full roof for better immersion.
    Tables can now be placed inside the tavern or outdoors.
    Taverns T2 and T3 have been merged for better balance and now unlock progressively.
    It's no longer necessary to hold a specific item to interact with objects (e.g., to fill a mug or wash dishes, you can now interact directly without selecting the exact item).

UI and Display Improvements

    In-world UI elements now fade with distance to reduce screen clutter and enhance visibility.
    General UI overhaul for a cleaner and more streamlined display.

 

Thank you all for your feedback, which helps improve the game! Try out this new version and share your thoughts on the Steam forum. 😀
